name: Sharpshooter
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity 13+ You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Bypass Cover
features.description: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

features.name: Firing in Melee
features.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

features.name: Long Shots
features.description: Attacking at long range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.
